{{Quote|Red Flight, High Flight Squadron, call &#39;em as you see &#39;em.|General Wedge Antilles, during the Battle of Adumar|<ref name="Adumar" />}}
'''High Flight Squadron''' was a [[Squadron/Legends|unit]] of [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wings]] assigned to the [[Quasar Fire-class cruiser-carrier/Legends|''Quasar Fire''-class carrier]] ''[[Battle Dog]]'' during the [[Hunt for Zsinj|Zsinj campaign]] in [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]]. The squadron's [[High Flight Squadron crest|insignia]] was that of an [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]] flying over a [[Mountain/Legends|mountain]] peak. The squadron flew in a [[Task force/Legends|strike group]] under [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] when attacking [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]]'s [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], [[Iron Fist (Executor-class)|''Iron Fist'']], at the [[Battle of Selaggis]]. [[Standard year/Legends|Years]] later, while assigned to the [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Allegiance (Imperial I-class)|''Allegiance'']], the squadron fought in the [[Battle of Adumar]], protecting the [[Adumar/Legends|planet]] from conquest by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==History==
{{Quote|This is High Flight Three. I'm hit by debris. Experiencing engine shutdown.|High Flight Three, during the Battle of Selaggis|<ref name="Solo" />}}
High Flight Squadron was a [[New Republic Starfighter Command/Legends|New Republic Starfighter Command]] [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]] [[Squadron/Legends|unit]] that was assigned<ref name="Solo" /> to the [[Quasar Fire-class cruiser-carrier/Legends|''Quasar Fire''-class carrier]] ''[[Battle Dog]]''<ref name="CSWE" /> during the [[Hunt for Zsinj|campaign]] to find the rogue [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]]<ref name="Solo" /> in [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]],<ref name="XW:SC Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[X-Wing: Solo Command]]'', including the [[Hunt for Zsinj]], to [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]].</ref> as part of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo's]] [[Solo Fleet|fleet]]. During the [[Battle of Selaggis]]&mdash;one of the [[Fleet/Legends|fleet's]] engagements during the hunt&mdash;[[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic's]] [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] led a [[Task force/Legends|task force]] of the fleet's [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]], including High Flight Squadron, into battle to attack Zsinj's [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]] [[Iron Fist (Executor-class)|''Iron Fist'']], which was trapped in the [[Selaggis system/Legends|Selaggis system]] due to [[Spy/Legends|double agent]] [[Gara Petothel|Lara Notsil's]] [[Saboteur/Legends|sabotage]].<ref name="Solo" />

[[File:WedgesEntireHead-ROTJ.png|thumb|left|250px|Commander Wedge Antilles led High Flight Squadron in the Battle of Selaggis.]]
Antilles and the forces advanced into the [[Asteroid field/Legends|ring field]] surrounding the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Selaggis VI]]. High Flight and [[Corsair Squadron]]s were ordered to proceed spinward of the planet to find the enemy [[Warship/Legends|warship]] while Rogue and [[Wraith Squadron]]s flew counter-spinward and [[Shadow Squadron (New Republic)|Shadow]] and [[Polearm Squadron/Legends|Polearm Squadrons]] proceeded on [[Scout/Legends|scouting]] runs. Once they spotted ''Iron Fist'' in the [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] field, the New Republic forces set up their attack, but [[Myn Donos]], [[Wraith Three]], ordered them to break off the ambush, suspecting a trap. During the ensuing maneuvers, ''Iron Fist'' fired on the asteroids to create a debris shield. [[High Flight Three]] was hit by debris and was forced to shut down while [[Shadow Twelve (New Republic)|Shadow Twelve]] was [[Death/Legends|killed]]. After protracted fighting that saw heavy New Republic starfighter casualties, Zsinj fled from Solo's fleet, fooling the New Republic forces into thinking they had destroyed his [[Super Star Destroyer/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]] by employing a [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]]-blocking [[Orbital nightcloak|nightcloak]] system and the decoy [[Starship/Legends|ship]] ''[[Second Death]]''.<ref name="Solo" />

In [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]],<ref name="XW:SoA Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[X-Wing: Starfighters of Adumar]]'', including the [[Battle of Adumar]], to [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]].</ref> High Flight Squadron was aboard the [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Imperial Star Destroyer]] [[Allegiance (Imperial I-class)|''Allegiance'']] when Antilles&mdash;who had become a General&mdash;negotiated with the people of the planet [[Adumar/Legends|Adumar]] for their entry into the New Republic. At this [[Time/Legends|time]], Antilles reflected on his belief that the squadron was a veteran unit that had seen numerous instances of combat. During the subsequent [[Battle of Adumar]], when the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] tried to subjugate the [[Adumar system/Legends|system]], Antilles led a total of 106 starfighters into the conflict. High Flight Squadron was included in the forward screen with three other units, while the remainder were held in reserve. As Antilles cleared the [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] for individual actions, [[High Flight Twelve]] reported the approach of Imperial starfighters. In the ensuing combat, one of the High Flight [[Unidentified High Flight Squadron pilot|pilots]] was killed. The battle ended with a New Republic victory for and [[Adumari Union]] alliance after the Imperials suffered heavy losses and the lead [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]], [[Agonizer (starship)|''Agonizer'']], took considerable damage.<ref name="Adumar" />

==Organization==
High Flight Squadron's members flew<ref name="Solo" /> [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom]]<ref name="EGW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> T-65 X-wing starfighters.<ref name="Solo" /> The unit's [[High Flight Squadron crest|insignia]] featured a single X-wing flying above a [[Mountain/Legends|mountain]] peak.<ref name="Adumar" />

==Behind the scenes==
High Flight Squadron first appeared in [[Aaron Allston]]'s novel ''[[X-Wing: Solo Command]]'',<ref name="Solo" /> released on [[February 2]], [[1999]].<ref name="Penguin-Paperback">{{PenguinRandomHouse|url=books/2518/solo-command-star-wars-legends-x-wing-by-aaron-allston|text=Solo Command: Star Wars Legends (X-Wing)}}</ref> Allston's novel ''[[X-Wing: Starfighters of Adumar]]'', released on [[August 3]] of that year,<ref name="Year By Year">''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, Updated and Expanded Edition]]''</ref> featured a pilot with the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] [[High Flight Beta Squadron|High Flight Beta]]. The novel did not clarify whether it was a separate squadron,<ref name="Adumar" /> but the [[2008]] reference book ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' confirmed the two High Flight Squadrons as separate units.<ref name="CSWE Beta">{{CSWECite|II|40|High Flight Beta Squadron}}</ref>
